name: Jaunpur
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Jaunpur District Administration identifies the state Bhulekh land-record system and all tehsils; the UP cadastral-map selector returned Jaunpur district, Sadar tehsil, and revenue-village options. A city-named Sadar option, Sipah Shahar Jaunpur, was listed with `hasData:false`; no claim is made that it contains the WUP point.
remainingUncertainty: Which revenue village and plot cover the WUP centroid; whether a bordering urban revenue village has public full geometry; whether the target city centre is excluded from the village-map dataset.
scopeLimits: The WUP locator is a settlement centroid, not a parcel identity. No citywide completeness is asserted. No owner/address/account/token values retained. At most three complete native parcel geometries may be retained for this city; none was obtained.
